items.headline: Lawrence McCutcheon, 5-time Pro Bowl RB for Rams, dies at 76
items.description: Lawrence McCutcheon, a five-time Pro Bowl running back for the Los Angeles Rams who went on to a long career in the team's front office, died Friday. He was 76.

items.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua misses practice, questionable vs. Raiders with calf injury
items.description: Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua (calf) will not practice Friday and is questionable to play Sunday against the Raiders, coach Sean McVay said.
